name: Execution - Field execution sessions management
description: Verifies field execution: starting/stopping sessions, recording labor hours, materials used, and checklists

planSteps.description: Log in as 'operador' role and navigate to /dashboard/execution
Assert that execution page shows pending and active sessions for the logged-in operator
Click 'Start Execution' on a pending order and verify a new execution session begins
Assert that the session timer starts and the status changes to 'in_progress'
Record labor hours: select crew members, enter hours worked, add notes
Log materials used: select from inventory list or add custom, enter quantities
Complete a preflight checklist for the session, verifying each item
Stop the execution session and verify the summary with total hours and costs
Assert that the execution session is saved and visible in the order's execution history
